prompt: Evening on a city sidewalk outside a laundromat: several ordinary adults have stopped walking to stare at the glowing phones in their hands, and through the laundromat window more people watch a television mounted on the wall. Their faces are lit pale blue from below by the screens, mouths open in shock. Wet pavement reflects the laundromat's fluorescent light, seen from street level at a three-quarter angle. Semi-realistic painted graphic-novel comic art with heavy dark ink linework, diagonal hatching in the shadows and crosshatching in the deepest shadows, realistic painted shading and muted desaturated colour. An ordinary present-day American city. Every sign, screen and surface is blank and plain.
